hooks.command: FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS"; case "$FILE" in *.ts|*.tsx) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && npx --no-install next lint --file "$FILE" 2>&1 | tail -40 || true ;; esac
FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS"; case "$FILE" in *.ts|*.tsx) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && npx --no-install tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -30 || true ;; esac
